# Pasquini Engineering, Inc.

> Full-service civil, structural, and architectural engineering and building design firm serving homeowners and contractors across California since 1990.

With 30+ years and 9,000+ projects, all plans are prepared in-house for permit. Pasquini Engineering is licensed in Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Idaho, Nevada, Oregon, Texas, Virginia, and Washington, with California offices in Bakersfield, Santa Rosa, Sacramento, San Jose, Paradise, the Central Coast, Central Valley, Long Beach, and Southern California.

## Services

- [Our Services](https://pasquiniengineering.com/our-services/): Overview of civil, structural, building design, construction management, planning, and surveying services.
- [Architectural Engineering](https://pasquiniengineering.com/california-architectural-engineering-services/): Architectural engineering services for residential and commercial projects in California.
- [Building Design](https://pasquiniengineering.com/california-building-design-firm/): Building design coordinated with clients, architects, and subcontractors while managing budget and resources.
- [Civil Engineering](https://pasquiniengineering.com/california-civil-engineering-services/): Site calculations and design that comply with local building codes and standards.
- [Structural Engineering](https://pasquiniengineering.com/california-structural-engineering-services/): Structural design for new buildings, additions, and alterations to existing structures.
- [Services For Contractors](https://pasquiniengineering.com/altadena-civil-engineering-services/): Engineering and rebuild plan sets for contractors, including Altadena fire rebuilds.
